## Standing operator rules
Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.

Never edit tests/conftest.py without posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-tests and waiting for @mira to approve it.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
Fix the dunning email scheduler in `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` sending reminders to customers who already paid. Router split is paused/superseded. Elasticsearch alias swap remains separate ongoing work.

## Ruled-out approaches
Wrapping webhook handlers in a retry decorator with 5 attempts re-sent customer emails multiple times.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Create `orders_v2`.
- [done] Reindex 18,432 documents; no failures.
- [done] Verify source and destination counts.
- [pending] Execute steps 6–8 in the specified order; exact commands are status unknown.
- [pending] Inspect and fix paid-customer filtering in the dunning scheduler.
- [pending] Diagnose indexing failures for recently updated invoice descriptions.

## Recent work
Webhook transport/server retries were implemented and validated: 44 tests passed; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed. Index baseline: `pytest -q tests/search/test_index.py` yielded 18 passed and 2 failures because rebuilt documents missed updated invoice descriptions. Likely bottlenecks are paginated invoice reads and per-document embedding serialization. No scheduler fix is implemented.
